metadata.experiment_title: Controlled PGD Convergence and Real JPEG Q50 Robustness Experiment
metadata.perturbation_type: Luminance-only (zero chromatic perturbation, Delta a* = 0, Delta b* = 0)

unprotected_control.description: Unprotected raw images without adversarial noise (0 optimization steps). Serves as negative control to measure baseline degradation from ordinary JPEG compression alone.

candidate_A_existing_production_baseline.description: Existing Varman 3.0 Strong Mode baseline: 25 steps PGD, fixed step size (alpha = eps / 7 = 0.0044818), momentum mu=0.9, EOT random JPEG quality 50-95.

experimental_alternatives.status_note: Candidates B-E are experimental alternatives tested under identical random conditions. They are preserved for comparative benchmarking but are NOT automatically promoted to the production baseline.

candidate_B_50_steps_fixed.candidate_name: Candidate B - Longer horizon (50 steps, fixed)

candidate_C_75_steps_fixed.candidate_name: Candidate C - Longer horizon (75 steps, fixed)
